description: This Rust source file defines a ChatHelper struct implementing the Helper trait, providing command injection and message sending functionalities for a chat system. It includes methods for adding a '+send' subcommand, handling message sending asynchronously, and building API requests. It also contains unit tests for core functions.

classes.name: ChatHelper
classes.description: A helper struct implementing chat message sending commands.

methods.name: inject_commands
methods.description: Injects the '+send' subcommand into a CLI command.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the '+send' command asynchronously, performing API request to send a message.

methods.name: build_send_request
methods.description: Constructs the API request parameters and body for sending a chat message.

methods.name: parse_send_args
methods.description: Parses command line arguments into a SendConfig struct.
